note: Subset of the round-0 side_1 camera calibration: 640x480 intrinsics and the per-line camera pose + operator-frame mapping for the two lines the paper overlays. Fit from the breadboard 1-inch hole lattice; operator translation pinned by the tabletop tape marks.

frame_convention.lattice: integer (i,j) indexes the breadboard HOLES; 1 lattice unit = 1 inch; holes sit at INTEGER operator coords, so t is integer per axis (the printed placement dots sit at half-integers BETWEEN holes)
frame_convention.operator_from_lattice: op_x = sx*j + t[0]; op_y = sy*i + t[1]  (swap=true for all three lines)
frame_convention.operator_frame: +x forward from operator, +y left from operator, inches (matches manifest operator_frame)
